visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A brown tabby cat sits atop a light-colored wooden cabinet or shelf, looking calmly at the lens. The background consists of a plain white wall, creating a simple, domestic setting. Bright indoor lighting illuminates the scene clearly. (2) A tricolor calico cat is shown resting on a circular scratching lounge located on a white wire shelving unit. The cat appears relaxed, looking towards the side. Various household storage containers and items are visible in the background. (3) A white cat with ginger patches is tucked inside a brown cardboard box on the carpeted floor. The cat looks directly at the camera with its head slightly tilted. The box is placed near other storage boxes and household supplies in a brightly lit room. (4) An orange tabby cat walks across a light-colored carpeted hallway towards the back of the room. It moves under a wooden bench. The background features a dark wooden door with a white notice posted on its surface. (5) A man's hand reaches out to a black Kwikset smart lock on a dark gray textured door. He presses a button and turns the handle to open the door, revealing a brightly lit interior hallway with white shoes on a green mat. (6) The brown tabby cat from earlier stands in the living room, looking toward the entryway. It then turns its head and starts walking away from the camera, moving deeper into the house towards a storage shelf. (7) A calico cat is perched on an upper shelf of a storage unit decorated with red and yellow festive banners. As the camera approaches, it ducks its head down, appearing to hide behind the decorative paper banners. (8) The man, wearing a black t-shirt, denim shorts, and white socks, enters the frame from the hallway. He carries a phone and looks around the living room. The white and ginger cat remains sitting inside its cardboard box nearby. (9) The man crouches down and lowers his head to the level of the white and ginger cat inside the box. He reaches out a hand to pet it, but the cat maintains a steady, neutral gaze, appearing unimpressed by his return. (10) The man stands up and walks away towards another room. The white and ginger cat immediately jumps out of the cardboard box and follows him at a brisk pace, its tail held high in the air. (11) In a hallway, the man picks up the white and ginger cat and holds it close to his chest. He hugs and kisses the cat's head multiple times while the cat makes facial expressions and opens its mouth.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) A lighthearted, mid-tempo acoustic guitar melody begins as the primary background music. A male voice speaks in a calm, casual tone, introducing the premise of the video. The acoustic texture is clean and bright. (2) The acoustic BGM continues steadily. The man's voice maintains a friendly and narrative prosody with clear articulation. A very faint ambient room tone is present but doesn't interfere with the speech. (3) A sharp mechanical click and metallic rattling are heard as the door lock is engaged and opened. The man's voice immediately shifts to a higher arousal level, shouting a loud greeting into the house. (4) Footsteps on a carpeted surface and the subtle rustle of clothing are audible as the camera moves. A high-pitched 'ding' sound effect triggers simultaneously with the appearance of a text overlay. (5) The man's voice becomes more animated and playful as he talks to the cats. The BGM remains consistent in its joyful major tonality. Another bubbly pop sound effect is used to punctuate a variety-style caption. (6) A distinct, sharp cat meow is heard as the cat reacts to being picked up. The man makes several smacking 'kiss' sounds and laughs. The acoustic music comes to a soft finish as the vocals continue with affectionate teasing.
